statement: A large replica rebuild under continuous foreground writes is data-safe, resource-bounded, throughput-measured, restartable, and convergence-safe, certified against a sealed bar by a fresh live rolling-restart-class terminal — closing the S1-S5 snapshot chain into production. Phase A wires every previously-dead production link with deterministic red-on-revert guards: a leader-only, role-gated, re-entrancy-guarded checkpoint cadence tick riding the 1s prepared-state-hold sweep (entry-count and byte thresholds; typed refusal for in-memory/control-plane partitions; retention sweep with the full pin set on fire); the onSnapshotCatchupNeeded dispatcher seam set at the shared ReplicaHandler setup so BOTH the bootstrap and join/durable-rejoin factories are covered; a bulk-channel registry instantiated and attached at the shared MessageRouter setup with peer dial via resolveNodeWebSocketAddress over node_endpoints; a bulk-connection/transfer-socket adapter routing chunk frames through sendChunkFrame (token bucket + pending bound authoritative, non-SENT treated as fatal, no double-pacing) with a consumer-facing close hook and offMessage; a peek-then-replay follower offer router mapping the OFFER descriptor raftGroupId to the local replica and driving orchestrateSnapshotCatchupInstall with replaceLocalReplicaService (localServices + setLocalReplica swap; CDC idempotency guarded); and a scaled sealed-generation fixture (~50k fat rows, tens of MiB, dozens of chunks) proving multi-chunk transfer, resume from a verified chunk boundary, pacing, and the corruption/truncation/duplicate/stale-epoch/cancel/restart attack battery deterministically. Phase B adds the snapshot-live-rebuild distributed scenario (preload a target partition to a declared row/byte floor via key-range-aware batched INSERT, continuous acknowledged-write-tracked load, stop a non-seed follower, wipeReplicaData in-container, restart, observe dispatch to transfer to install to recreate to resume, convergence + acknowledged-write reconciliation) emitting the R5 evidence as additive loadMetrics/details/top-level report fields with fidelity 'live' — this defines the P0 slice of the scale-certification evidence contract. Phase C seals a snapshot-live-rebuild bar (safety floor: zero stale-source/corrupt/node-exit/oracle-blind, zero lost acknowledged writes, zero hard invariant breaches, install outcomes only installed-and-recreated on success, zero install-state-conflict, boundary monotonic; plus a Wilson-lower-bound rebuild-success rate and foreground non-starvation + resource fractions) via a gate-verdict consumer change, and after a mechanistic engagement pass and gate:preflight runs the N>=15 certification whose fresh terminal report is the sealed-bar evidence; all S1-S5 and gated-compaction guard suites stay unweakened and CL-040/041/042 green throughout.
